provenance.changes: Dissolved 10 neighborhood polygons for city P-code C6147, simplified the outline, and clipped it to the official urban data and stock province.
provenance.note: Local Druze authorities governed Suwayda city at the opening date. The neighborhood union covers the documented urban city only; other areas of the governorate have separate or disputed authorities.

provenance.changes: Dissolved 23 neighborhood polygons for city P-code C5710, simplified the outline, and clipped it to the official urban data and stock province.
provenance.note: The Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria governed Raqqa through its local civilian institutions at the opening date. The neighborhood union covers the city only; other areas of the governorate have separate or disputed authorities.
